articles.summary: We are happy to announce our partnership with the lab of Prof.Dr.Ir. Nienke Bosschaart at the University of Twente! Prof.Dr.Ir. Bosschaart’s lab uses optical technologies to learn more about the physiology of lactation. We are excited to collaborate with them! The NearWave Scanner is currently intended for investigational use only.
articles.title: NearWave Partners with the Lab of Prof.Dr.Ir. Nienke Bosschaart at the University of Twente
